name: RetroAPI
description: Block, Item, Recipe, Entity, Dimension Registration API for Legacy Minecraft. Supports Ornithe and Babric. Optionally Works with StationAPI.

custom.//: Interface injection: consumers see Block/Item already implementing the RetroAPI access interfaces, so `block.strength(...)` / `item.tool(...)` work WITHOUT casting to (RetroBlockAccess)/(RetroItemAccess). The mixins supply the implementations at runtime; this only teaches the compiler.
custom.//2: Loom matches these keys against the INTERMEDIARY names of the consumer's toolchain, and the two toolchains RetroAPI ships for do not share a namespace: Ornithe uses calamus gen2 (net/minecraft/unmapped/C_81592558 = Block, C_98888256 = Item) while babric uses the older class_N names (class_17 = Block, class_124 = Item). Only the gen1 pair was listed here, so on the Ornithe build - the one the maven/docs point at - nothing was ever injected and consumers had to cast. Both namespaces are listed now; a key that does not resolve in the active namespace is ignored, so this is safe in either.
